topic: COD returns: Rs 12,000/month lost on returned parcels (lawn suits)
lines: Barah hazaar rupay parcel ban kar wapas aa rahe hain.
Lawn suit bheja, customer ne phone nahi uthaya.
Sau mein se paintees wapas, har parcel par teen sau pachaas rupay.
Fix: order aate hi WhatsApp par confirm karwao.
Haan bola to parcel nikalta hai, nahi bola to paise bache.
Guides ke mutabiq, wapsi aadhi reh sakti hai.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
